decisions.reason: Although only mentioned on the website, the firm's organisational slack and the product's fit with existing laser marking capabilities suggest no performance shortfall yet, so it is kept while its results remain uncertain.
Its dedicated website page in both years and the firm's growth in coding and marking indicate results around or above aspiration levels, so no problemistic search is triggered.
The product's own page in 2023 and 2024 and its closeness to the established offer imply stable performance relative to aspirations, making a drop unlikely.
As a flagship shown on the home page and aligned with the firm's strategic direction, it clearly signals positive results above aspirations and receives strong managerial support.
The explicit 'New' launch and dedicated page indicate active promotion, and the firm's slack allows carrying this still-new product while its performance is assessed.
The Blechexpo award provides a positive external signal that likely exceeds aspirations, so despite only a website mention, the firm keeps the product to build on its success.
